goal: Define a named key store with one or more signing prefixes
success_output: Store model with title and cypher map
notes: Prefix names are application-level identifiers and are not JWT claims

goal: Create a portable signed token for a resource identifier
notes: Payload remains visible because the protocol signs but does not encrypt

goal: Recover and validate the ID payload from a full token
notes: Prefix selects the cypher before signature verification

goal: Require selected scope fields or custom scope rules
success_output: Failure when mandatory scope requirements are not met

goal: Accept tokens signed with the previous secret during migration
success_output: Verified payload when alternate secret succeeds
notes: Current secret is tried first and alternate secret is a fallback

goal: Return deterministic failure details for malformed expired or mismatched tokens
success_output: Failure result with step and message
notes: Callers should branch on result status rather than exceptions
